correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Eq.(30) exactly, checked the Rayleigh quotient and alpha ranges for any real symmetric model, applied the L-smooth descent lemma blockwise, minimized the resulting concave coefficient at exactly attainable endpoints B=0 and B=M, and solved both inequalities in all parameter regimes. The scalar quadratic equality constructions prove sharpness; a connected two-agent strongly convex quadratic family realizes the source-declared L and approaches the same obstruction below the threshold. Executed exact rational checker from package script with VERIFY_OK. No finite enumeration was treated as proof.

value.rationale: The denominator b_i controls trial-step size, and the published sufficient quarter-descent threshold 2(L+M) is up to nine times too large for the concrete implemented Cauchy rule. The exact two-regime frontier, extremal models, and connected-network limiting obstructions show a quantitative usable relaxation with a structural L/M switch. This is not a merely renamed descent lemma or tiny numerical adjustment; it isolates an implementable algorithm choice and an exact non-improvable safeguard, while explicitly not claiming a new outer complexity theorem.
